settings.title: Settings
settings.unavailable: The settings could not be loaded. You need taerra.config and to be logged in.
settings.readOnly: Can only be changed in game with {command}, since a wrong value can make the map unreachable
settings.section.worlds.hint: Which worlds are on the map, in which order, and what they are called there. Private worlds only show to logged-in players with taerra.world.<world>. In a world with private players, only those with taerra.players.<world> see where everyone is.
settings.section.limits.hint: Where the map of each world ends, so it stops where your playable area does. A new limit renders that world again, and tiles outside disappear once it's done.
settings.section.map.hint: How the map presents itself, in the browser, in chat apps and in game.
settings.section.layers.hint: The layers TAERRA draws itself, and which layers only players with permission see.
settings.markers.spawn.enabled.hint: A marker on each world's spawn point, moved along when the spawn moves.
On for viewers who haven't switched it themselves.
settings.section.rendering.hint: How often changes are drawn, and how much of the server the renderer may use. Changes apply right away.
settings.section.web.hint: The address and port the map listens on. Changed in game only, so the page you are on can't lock itself out.
settings.web.name: Server name
settings.web.name.hint: Beside TAERRA in the header, as the page title and in link previews.
settings.web.public-url.hint: Where players open the map, for login links and link previews.
settings.join-hint.interval-days.hint: How often a player is reminded of the map when joining. 0 turns it off.
settings.rendering.update-interval.hint: How often world changes are drawn. 0 draws them as they happen.
settings.rendering.render-threads.hint: 0 uses half the CPU cores, always leaving two to the game.
settings.cache.max-tiles.hint: Tiles kept in memory, about 256 KB each. 0 sizes it from the server's memory.
settings.cache.max-chunks.hint: Chunks kept in memory for the isometric view, about 19 KB each. More speeds up large renders. 0 sizes it from the server's memory.
settings.markers.worldborder.enabled.hin: The vanilla world border and ChunkyBorder's borders.
settings.markers.worldborder.shown-by-de: On for viewers who haven't switched it themselves.
settings.markers.worldguard.enabled.hint: Needs WorldGuard installed. It shows who owns and builds on which land, so keep it private.
settings.markers.worldguard.shown-by-def: On for viewers who haven't switched it themselves.
settings.markers.towny.enabled.hint: Needs Towny installed. Each town with its mayor, nation and residents.
On for viewers who haven't switched it themselves.
settings.markers.griefprevention.enabled: Needs GriefPrevention installed. It shows where players live, so keep it private.
settings.markers.griefprevention.shown-b: On for viewers who haven't switched it themselves.
settings.markers.plotsquared.enabled.hin: Needs PlotSquared installed. Each claimed plot with its owners, trusted players and members.

settings.markers.loaded-chunks.enabled.h: Outlined by load level. It shows where players are, so keep it private.
